purpose: Decorative bento illustrations for event briefs, with CV&DI-style people and a genuine transparent background.

images.styleTransferPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: revised decorative illustration for the main bento card of an existing educational conference slide.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET. Preserve its exact 1536x1024 canvas, pale peach background, scene composition, object positions, negative space, and peach/teal/turquoise palette.
Input image 2: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, taken from the user's CV&DI slide illustrations (introduction-ideas). Copy its HUMAN DRAWING LANGUAGE: rounded dark continuous outlines, simple clearly drawn faces, small dark oval eyes, curved eyebrows, very simple nose and mouth, expressive but restrained gestures, rounded hands with a few clear finger strokes, broad matte light fills, dark solid hair, adult proportions and approachable editorial character.
Input image 3: secondary STYLE REFERENCE ONLY from CV&DI slides (scenario-media), clarifying the rounded contour weight and simple facial language. Do not copy its monitor, scene, lettering, green palette, or captions.
Primary request: change ONLY the PEOPLE in input image 1 into the people style of the CV&DI slide references. Use clearly visible uniform dark teal #183c43 outlines on faces, hands, clothing and hair. Faces and hands should be pale cream rather than orange; clothing uses muted pale turquoise, cream or terracotta while maintaining the existing overall palette. Use the reference's friendly simple facial expressions and rounded gestures, not featureless color-block silhouettes.
Constraints: preserve every existing non-human object and the arrangement, overall subject, exact image bounds, main peach background #ffd3b3, open top and lower areas, and bento-related map panels. Do not add extra people, props, text, labels, logos, gradients, grain, texture, shadows, 3D or watermarks. Do not add visual clutter or foliage. Keep people complete and naturally seated, hands anatomically coherent. This is a specific edit, not a redesign.
Specific invariants: Preserve the two collaborating people, the open notebook, laptop, checklist, pencil, connected panels and plant in their existing positions. Redraw the two people with the CV&DI outlined, simple-faced character style.
images.backgroundExtractionPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Input image: edit target. Remove only the outer peach background, including empty gaps between separate objects, to create a genuinely TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with an actual alpha channel. This will sit over an existing colored bento card.
Preserve the entire illustrated cluster exactly: all CV&DI-style outlined people, their faces and hands, dark teal outlines, hair, clothes, furniture, screens, books, plants, charts, rounded background diagram panels, cream fills and turquoise/terracotta accents. Preserve the opaque fills INSIDE the people and objects, including cream faces and papers. The peach empty canvas outside those subjects must become alpha zero. No peach rectangular backdrop, no colored cloud, no glow, no shadows, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no matte, no new content.
Frame as a WIDE LANDSCAPE cutout with only modest transparent margins around the whole existing illustrated cluster; trim the large empty top and bottom margins. Preserve all proportions and relative object positions. Do not crop heads, hands, books or outside props. Keep crisp anti-aliased contours. No text, no watermarks. Change the background and empty framing only; do not redraw the scene.
